title: Pack release
description: The single JSON document the build produces from a pack's source files, and the unit loadRuleset takes. Formulas stay as written; `formulas` maps each formula's text to its canonical text and parsed tree.

i18n.description: Translations bundled with this release, by language tag (normally only the default language).

formulas.description: Every formula in the release written as text, compiled: source text → { text (canonical), tree }. Ports can walk trees without a parser; formulas elsewhere in the release stay as written.
